```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** Virtual Lab Management System Test Suite

**Target Application:** Virtual Lab Management System

**Target Platform:** Heroku with Ver. 5.7.21 MySQL Database

**Target Users:** Lab Incharge, Chemist, Admin, Patient

**Test Cases:**

| Test Case ID | Title | Requirement ID(s) | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Lab Incharge can perform lab tests and update reports | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Positive | Lab Incharge is logged in | Test data for lab test and report | Perform lab test, update report, set flag in prescription | Report is updated, flag is set in prescription |
| TC-002 | Lab Incharge cannot update reports without being logged in | VIRTUA-2.3-13 | Negative | User is not logged in | Test data for lab test and report | Attempt to update report | Error message is displayed |
| TC-003 | Chemist can deliver medicine to the concerned patient | VIRTUA-2.3-14 | Positive | Chemist is logged in | Patient information and medicine details | Deliver medicine to patient, set flag in prescription | Medicine is delivered, flag is set in prescription |
| TC-004 | Admin and Patient can view invoice and reports | UC-14 | Positive | Admin and Patient are logged in | Appointment details | View invoice and reports | Invoice and reports are displayed |
| TC-005 | System is deployed on Heroku platform | VIRTUA-2.4-1 | Constraint | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is deployed on Heroku platform |
| TC-006 | System is accessed via Hospital website | VIRTUA-2.4-2 | Interface | N/A | N/A | N/A | System is accessible via Hospital website |
| TC-007 | System supports multiple operating systems | VIRTUA-2.4-3 | Constraint | N/A | N/A | N/A | System supports MS Windows, Unix, Linux, and Apple Mac |
| TC-008 | Invoices and prescriptions can be printed and stored | VIRTUA-2.4-4 | Functional | N/A | N/A | Print and store invoices and prescriptions | Invoices and prescriptions are printed and stored |
| TC-009 | System prevents full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity | VIRTUA-2.5-1 | Constraint | N/A | N/A | N/A | System prevents full scan of Patient Consultation Request Entity |

```
